subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who has too much admiration for himself or herself
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Narcissist"** means someone who has an excessive admiration for themselves. (आत्ममुग्ध व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **John's narcissistic behavior makes it difficult for him to maintain relationships.
 
 
 
• **"Narcissist" **refers to a person who is overly self-involved, often vain and selfish. (आत्मप्रेमी)
 
 
• **Example: **Her constant need for attention and admiration reveals her narcissistic tendencies.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct one-word substitute for someone who has too much admiration for themselves is **'Narcissist'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pantheist **(सर्वेश्वरवादी): A person who believes that God is present in all natural things.

 
 
• **Example:** As a pantheist, she finds spirituality in nature and the universe.
 
 
 
• **Misogamist **(विवाह विरोधी): A person who hates marriage.
 
 
• **Example: **His views on marriage make him a misogamist.
 
 
 
• **Misanthropist** (मनुष्यद्वेषी): A person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society.
 
 
• **Example:** The old man was a misanthropist who lived alone in the woods.
 
 

109:Ta71,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
